notes:
- Press feedback scales the whole control again: the press spring on the Settings pills, the motion and joke chips, the comment bar, the Nova back buttons, the relation cards and the profile's open-in-AniList button was installed inside the control's own clip and background, so a tap shrank the label while the surface it sits on stayed put.
- Counts no longer tick past their number: the stats banner total and a comment's like count animated on a spatial spring that overshoots an integer, so a like could visibly go 41, 43, 41. Counts use the non-overshooting effects spring now.
- A cancelled swipe settles inside its button: the Planning button's swipe fill returned on a bouncy spring that travelled past zero, showing the container behind it at the end of every cancelled drag.
- The cover viewer's title list follows the motion setting: the title-spellings disclosure was still using Compose's default fade and expand, so it ignored the Motion style and Instant.
- A profile banner stops drifting off screen: the infinite sweep kept running after the header had scrolled out of the window.
- Fixed-size crossfades no longer re-measure: the animated counter, the refresh button and the login icon rail animated their box while swapping content of a known size.
- The comment skeleton moves on the app's spring: the waiting rows were the one list slot without a placement spec.

Build 681.
